svg.text: Backend & Full-Stack Engineer · AI Systems & Cloud Infrastructure

g.text: Hi, I’m Sahajpreet.
I build backend services and full-stack applications. For a patent research
tool, I connected a Next.js frontend to AWS APIs and made long-running
searches resumable. At ASU’s AI Cloud Innovation Center I worked on getting a
question to the right agent, a source into the answer, and the whole thing
running on AWS. Ask me about the time a chatbot found the answer and still
lost the citation.
Languages
SQL
Applications
Cloud & deployment
AI & retrieval
Data & operations
I‑ECHO · Multi-agent RAG on AWS
I added the EKS Fargate stack and integrated API Gateway and the load
balancer. I refined routing to specialist agents, fixed streaming behavior,
and added citation handling with document links. My 10 merged PRs also include
PowerPoint-to-PDF ingestion and session management.
I‑ECHO uses AWS Bedrock and Strands to route questions about tuberculosis and
agriculture to domain-specific agents. The ingestion pipeline makes uploaded
slide decks available for retrieval. On the response side, I fixed how the
orchestrator handles thinking tags during streaming and added an endpoint that
generates links to cited documents.
MLH URL Shortener · Backend performance
I added Redis redirect caching with invalidation, reduced database and
serialization overhead, and tuned Gunicorn and Nginx. In the merged PR’s
development benchmark, GET /urls handled 76.6% more requests per second with
43.4% lower latency. All 174 existing tests passed.
For updates, I limited database writes to the fields that changed. For list
endpoints, I returned dictionaries directly to avoid constructing model
objects for every row. Redirects use Redis with invalidation when a URL
changes or is deleted. I also adjusted PostgreSQL WAL settings, Nginx response
buffers, and Gunicorn connection reuse.
HOPE · Crisis resource chatbot
I improved geographic resource search, restored missing citations by adding a
retrieval step before generation, and fixed session handling so follow-up
messages retained context. I also migrated inference to Amazon Nova 2 Lite.
HOPE connects users with WestCare Arizona resources. I worked on location-
aware search and the location questionnaire, corrected how the first request
obtains a Bedrock session ID, and carried that ID into later messages. I also
fixed source display for off-topic responses, updated cross-region inference
permissions, and wrote a customization guide.
Patent Novelty Assessment
Integrated deployment across Next.js, API Gateway, and Lambda. Added early
stopping and resume for patent and literature searches, with persisted
progress and clearer error feedback.
The platform searches patent databases and academic literature for prior art.
I connected the frontend to handlers for agent invocation, S3 uploads, and
DynamoDB-backed data. For searches that outlast a page visit, I updated
polling and state persistence so users can resume an ongoing search, see the
final result count, and understand when a search stopped early.
NASWA Multilingual RAG Chatbot
Added CDK infrastructure and a Bedrock Lambda handler, English and Spanish
selection, and conversation memory. Refactored retrieval to use Bedrock
RetrieveAndGenerate with Guardrails.
The assistant helps National Association of State Workforce Agencies users
query documents in English or Spanish and inspect the sources behind an
answer. I carried the language choice into both retrieval and direct prompts,
improved the mapping from retrieved documents to sources, and made follow-up
queries use conversation context.
Multi-Agent Inference-Time Evaluation
Evaluated specialist agents across five question domains using techniques such
as code execution and retries with error feedback. Accuracy rose from 20.5% to
26% on 200 mixed examples.
The five domains were math, coding, planning, common sense, and future
prediction. I tested generated code, fed execution errors back to the model
for another attempt, and compared those results with direct generation,
prompting, and voting. On 100 coding examples, execution with retries reached
32%, compared with 25% for direct generation. The experiments also exposed
weaker approaches, including a math judge that scored below 10%.
Guardian — The Algorithmic Auditor
AWS and Next.js fairness-auditing prototype with disparate-impact and proxy-
bias checks. My commits cover project setup, CSV upload validation, test data,
and architecture and testing guides.
Guardian pairs a Next.js dashboard with a Python Lambda ingestion and bias-
analysis pipeline. Users upload a CSV, inspect group selection rates and
disparate-impact checks, and explore the results with a Bedrock-powered
Socratic tutor. I initialized the project, added upload-size validation and a
sample dataset, and documented architecture, deployment, and testing.
TravelBuddy
Built out the Swift UI and navigation and integrated text and image generation
APIs.
My iOS work included the login screen, the initial navigation flow, and
integration of the screens into a working interface. I then connected both
generation APIs and removed the earlier SwiftData dependency as part of that
integration.
PrepU
Added a summarizer, an API module, and face and emotion analysis modules for
interview tooling.
PrepU combines a React frontend with Python modules. My authored commits
introduced the summarizer, API integration module, face detection, and emotion
analysis, giving the project separate components for processing text and
visual input.
InterviewIQ
This React mock interview prototype pairs video playback with structured
feedback on answers.
The interviewer view presents a behavioral question alongside a recorded
response. It requests feedback from the interview API, displays a rating,
strengths, weaknesses, and suggested improvements, and synchronizes the
returned expression labels with the video timeline.
ASDA
Authored nine upstream commits, including a crawler and Flask UI updates to a
Form 990 search prototype.
The prototype helps users explore nonprofit tax filings by city, state, gross
revenue, and net revenue. My work spanned the JavaScript crawler and retrieval
code, HTML templates and styles, and formatting changes in the Flask
application.
AWS AI Chatbot for Corrections
Updated the infrastructure deployment guide.
The project provisions an Amazon Q Business assistant with a web crawler,
index, and retriever through AWS CDK. My upstream change was to the
infrastructure-as-code deployment guide used to set up that stack.
